name: Shiprazor Shipping Price
author: shiprazor

sections.description:
Shiprazor Shipping Price is a WooCommerce plugin that allows store owners to integrate Shiprazor’s API to calculate shipping rates dynamically. The plugin provides a seamless and configurable way to define shipping costs, with additional features such as discount rules based on cart values.

Features:

  • Dynamic shipping rates using Shiprazor’s API
  • Ability to define discount rules based on cart values
  • Configurable in WooCommerce shipping settings
  • Compatible with all WooCommerce stores

External Services

This plugin connects to the Shiprazor API to obtain shipping rate estimations dynamically. The API integration is essential for the plugin to calculate and display accurate shipping rates during the checkout process.

Details about the Shiprazor API:

  • What the service is and what it is used for:
    The Shiprazor API is used to fetch shipping rates based on cart details such as item weight, dimensions, and destination.

  • What data is sent and when:
    The following data is sent to the Shiprazor API when calculating shipping rates during checkout:

    • Cart items’ weight and dimensions
    • Destination address (e.g., ZIP code, city, and country)

  • Why the data is sent:
    The data is sent to provide accurate shipping rate calculations tailored to the user’s cart and destination.

  • Service provider:
    This service is provided by Shiprazor. You can review their terms of service and privacy policy at the following links:

    • Shiprazor Terms of Service
    • Shiprazor Privacy Policy

sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin .zip file from this repository.
  2. Upload the plugin folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory or upload the .zip file via the WordPress admin.
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  4. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Shipping to configure the plugin.
sections.faq:
What does this plugin do?

The plugin calculates shipping rates dynamically using the Shiprazor API and allows you to define discount rules based on cart values.

Do I need an API key?

Yes, you will need to sign up with Shiprazor to obtain an API key for shipping rate calculations.

How do I configure the discount rules?

In WooCommerce shipping settings, you can add, remove, and modify discount rules based on minimum and maximum cart values, as well as set percentage discounts.

Is it compatible with all versions of WooCommerce?

The plugin has been tested with WooCommerce 4.0+ and WordPress 5.0+. We recommend testing with your theme and other plugins before using it on a live site.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

Initial release of Shiprazor Shipping Price plugin.

1.0.1

  1. Minor bug fixes.
  2. New service provider added.

1.0.2

  1. Minor bug fix.

1.0.3

  1. Minor bug fix.

2.0.0

  1. Plugin controls modifications.
  2. Minor bug fix.

3.0.0

  1. Plugin controls modifications.
  2. Minor bug fix.

3.0.1

  1. Automize connectivity with shiprazor.
  2. Minor bug fix.

3.0.2

  1. Added custom WooCommerce order status “Shipped” (shown after Processing).
  2. Shiprazor Shipping is added automatically to every shipping zone on activate and when new zones are saved.
  3. Fixed zone shipping method setup (method title, instance settings) to resolve blank names and “Invalid shipping method” in zone settings.
  4. Store connection credentials apply to all zone instances for live rates at checkout.

3.0.3

  1. Restored the Shiprazor sub-tab under WooCommerce > Settings > Shipping (zone methods no longer hide it).
  2. Restored the Connect with Shiprazor screen and automatic API key setup on that tab (same flow as 3.0.1).
  3. Fixed global method init order so stored credentials and connection status load correctly before the connect UI renders.
  4. Admin connect scripts and styles load only on the Shiprazor settings section.

3.0.4

  1. Fixed shipping zone sync and instance repair running on admin-ajax requests, which could break storefront AJAX (for example variable products showing as out of stock).
  2. Corrected Shiprazor API base URLs for staging and production connect/rates endpoints.

3.0.5

  1. Fixed malformed Shiprazor API base URL constants that could prevent connect and checkout rate requests from reaching the correct endpoints.
  2. Minor admin Connect screen text fixes (valid HTML in translated feature list strings).

3.0.6

  1. Reverted plugin codebase to the 3.0.1 release baseline (automated Shiprazor connectivity and related fixes from that version).
  2. Rolled back changes shipped in 3.0.2 through 3.0.5, including the Shipped order status, automatic shipping zone sync, restored settings tab work, and later API base URL fixes.
  3. Use this release if you need the pre–3.0.2 behavior after problems on 3.0.2–3.0.5; update from tags/3.0.1 equivalent sources dated 29 June 2026.

3.0.7

  1. Added a Shiprazor column on the WooCommerce orders list (legacy and HPOS) with Open and Track links from order meta.
  2. Fixed checkout rate requests so the cart total uses each product unit price.
